owner_scope_confirmation.interpretation: The owner selected option C from a3b-resume-preregistration-draft-v3: a 600 s cumulative T1-A cap for one cycle-3 continuation. This selection authorizes preparation of the v3 protocol, driver, preflight and addendum. It does not authorize solver execution; a separate owner authorization quoting the final v3 hashes is required.
scope_corrections: T1-A continuation only; T1-B through T1-E are not authorized by this selection.
The 600 s cap is cumulative and includes the 112.094 s failed invocation and the 266.469 s two-cycle invocation.
The 600 s cap does not guarantee cycle 3 completes; the frozen cap guard remains authoritative.
No periodicity, steady-state, supported-resolution-domain or predictive claim is added.

purpose.primary: Complete T1-A cycle 3 from the exact v2 checkpoint under a versioned 600 s continuation protocol, preserving the audited cycles 1-2 and their lineage.
decision_use: If cycle 3 completes and passes audit: T1-A has three audited cycles and a T1-A-only atol_obs freeze may be prepared; the matrix still requires T1-B..E under separate authorization.
If cycle 3 does not complete within the 600 s cap: record T1-A PARTIAL again with exact evidence; no freeze and no comparison.
This protocol does not produce a power or torque curve and does not validate the engine experimentally.
purpose.administrative_boundary: This is one cycle-3 continuation with one decision output. It does not authorize T1-B..E, does not expand the matrix and does not create additional approval layers beyond the final execution authorization.

entries.failure: T1-A cap exceeded: projected 542.568 s > 525 s

parent_lineage.parent_binding_canonicalization: SHA-256 of UTF-8 bytes of json.dumps(binding, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':')).

scope.tier_definition: Design T1 = T0 + temporal CFL 0.1 + the coarsest attainable spatial level (18 total cells), with the shared base configuration counted once.

configuration_set.role: base; shared by both arms; continuation from the v2 checkpoint

identity_invariants.note: Variant, RPM, fuel, mechanical-loss model and periodicity contract are fixed to the A3a identity. Each configuration has its own configuration_sha256 recorded in its receipt.

conservation_contract.audit: Every cycle must be audit_recomputed=true and admissible; the existing independent auditor is not modified.

worker_policy.T1-A_T1-B_T1-C: 1 worker, sequential. Two 48-cell workers at ~2.0 GiB each equal 100% of the aggregate cap.
worker_policy.T1-D_T1-E: 28/18-cell workers: up to 3/4 workers allowed under the aggregate cap; sequential is the default.

carry_forward.rule: Carry-forward entries are charged as-is. No reclassification, subtraction, refund or retry credit is permitted.

budget.cap_behavior: A configuration that reaches its cap is classified PARTIAL with exact evidence. No extension, no retry, no post-hoc horizon change.

allowed: One T1-A invocation at invocation_index 2, running cycle 3 only from the exact v2 checkpoint.
Restoring the parent engine and periodicity snapshots; appending cycle 3 to the parent records.
Writing new v3 artifacts under T1-A/v3/ and a new v3 ledger; leaving all v2 artifacts byte-for-byte unchanged.
prohibited: Re-running cycles 1 or 2 as new solver state.
Using a checkpoint other than the exact parent checkpoint sha256 3b1203b6a1e4cb162910b8c011f4f562b693ee04f8f2801051f122416b11fcba.
Modifying the v2 protocol, driver, addendum, authorization, checkpoint, result, ledger or invocation artifacts.
Substituting or reclassifying the 112.094 s failed charge or the 266.469 s partial charge.
Changing the 600 s T1-A cap, the 4320 s global cap, the 600 s per-invocation cap or the 3072 MiB memory limit after this freeze.
continuation_rules.lineage_acceptance: The v3 driver must compare the parent checkpoint binding to parent_lineage.parent_binding and require equality on every scientific field; only protocol_sha256 and driver_sha256 may differ between the parent and v3 bindings, and both are bound explicitly in the v3 lineage.
continuation_rules.combined_analysis: T1-A cycles 1-2 come from the parent result; cycle 3 comes from the v3 result. The analysis-freeze and sensitivity report must label the lineage and must not present the v3 run as a standalone three-cycle run.

stop_conditions: NaN or Inf in an accepted or rejected step, checkpoint, or primary.
Identity mismatch between the configured identity and the frozen identity.
Conservation mismatch beyond the frozen contract.
No accepted cycle within the configuration cap (no-progress).
Any parent lineage hash, binding field or ledger entry mismatch.
Any attempted write to a v2 artifact path or any attempted T1-B..E start.

rejection_share.soft_alarm_effect: Flags the configuration for interpretation; it does not invalidate the run and does not trigger a stop.
rejection_share.reporting: Per configuration and per cycle: rejected, attempted, accepted, rejection share.

effective_timestep_reporting.reason: With a high rejection share the nominal max_cfl can overstate the effective temporal resolution.
effective_timestep_reporting.note: These fields were not recorded in A3a; A3b adds them as observables, not as new acceptance gates.

analysis_plan.observable_source: The audited per-cycle primary produced by make_integrated_cycle_primary; no derived or fitted quantity is added.

comparison_method.temporal_arm: At 48 cells, compare successive CFL pairs (0.4 vs 0.2) and (0.2 vs 0.1) at the same cycle index; the finer level is the denominator.
comparison_method.spatial_arm: At CFL 0.4, compare successive mesh pairs (18 vs 28) and (28 vs 48) at the same cycle index; the finer mesh is the denominator.
comparison_method.aggregation: Report every cycle index separately and a per-observable summary; do not average cycles before applying the tolerance.
comparison_method.no_interpolation: No interpolation in cycle index or angle; no Richardson extrapolation as a result, error bound, or acceptance input.

analysis_plan.lineage_requirement: The analysis-freeze and sensitivity report must consume the parent T1-A cycles 1-2 plus the v3 cycle 3 with an explicit lineage label. A T1-A-only freeze is not a temporal or spatial sensitivity result.

tolerance_policy.delta_definition: Difference between the two compared levels at the same cycle index; denominator is |x_fine|, never the coarse level.
tolerance_policy.x_base_source: Base configuration T1-A (48 cells / CFL 0.4) at the same cycle index; for T1-A itself the three combined cycles are the base record, not a cross-configuration comparison.

declared_resolution_floors.mass_observables_kg: the frozen conservation-noise floor recorded in the analysis-freeze table, not lower than the A3a observed maximum |mass residual| of 1.2891841457210451e-18 kg
declared_resolution_floors.power_torque_pressure_observables: 0 unless the frozen contract declares a resolution; the 5% relative term dominates away from zero

tolerance_policy.near_zero_rule: If |x_fine| <= atol_obs, the relative criterion does not apply and only the absolute band governs.
tolerance_policy.sign_crossing_rule: A sign crossing between levels with magnitude > atol_obs is NOT_CONVERGED; a crossing is never a PASS by itself. crankcase_gas_work_J is the declared witness case.

atol_freeze_order.requirement: The numeric atol_obs table is derived from the combined T1-A cycles 1-3 and committed in results/integrated-solver-verification-v1/a3b-analysis-freeze-v3.json BEFORE any cross-config comparison.
atol_freeze_order.reason: The base values are produced by this matrix; the numeric table cannot be frozen before the base run exists, but it is frozen before any comparison, which preserves the design intent.
atol_freeze_order.immutability: After the v3 analysis-freeze commit, the table cannot be changed; any change requires a new preregistration.

classification.converging_monotone: |delta| decreases in both consecutive pairs and the finest-pair delta meets the tolerance.
classification.observed_order: p is a diagnostic consistency label only; p in [0.5, 1.5] means 'consistent with first order' and is never an acceptance criterion; p is not computed from non-monotone pairs or ratio != 2.
classification.overall_output: A sensitivity table with raw deltas, the per-observable classification, and one bounded statement for the studied domain. No global convergence verdict.

analysis_plan.cost_separation: Exclusive timers per configuration and cycle, shares of wall time, and an explicit single-sample statement. The cost model is validated against the T1 measurements, not assumed.
analysis_plan.report: One v3 analysis receipt and one v3 sensitivity report under results/integrated-solver-verification-v1/; raw artifacts remain under DINO_ARTIFACT_ROOT.

allowed: Numerical sensitivity of the transient solution over cycles 1-3 at the studied mesh/CFL configurations.
A bounded supported-domain statement only if the preregistered tolerance is met: 'precision numerica soportada a la par malla/CFL estudiada'.
Explicit 'error no acotado - curvas exploratorias, no predictivas' if the tolerance is not met.
not_allowed: Definitive convergence closure of the solver.
Steady-state convergence or periodicity identification from three cycles.
Any predictive power-curve or torque-curve claim.
Extrapolation beyond the studied mesh/CFL domain.
A supported resolution domain from T1-A alone; T1-B..E are required for temporal and spatial sensitivity.

periodicity.reason: Three cycles are insufficient for lag1/lag2 periodicity acceptance. A3a with 8 cycles already returned EXECUTED_NO_PERIOD_ACCEPTED (13/13 comparisons failed, accepted_period null, worst lag1 1.31% vs 0.2% threshold).
periodicity.detector_use: The detector may run for recording, but its output is not used as a convergence or acceptance criterion in A3b.

claim_boundaries.necessary_not_sufficient: Convergence is necessary but not sufficient; no experimental validation and no predictive claim are made.

artifacts.external: Raw primaries, checkpoints, manifests and logs under DINO_ARTIFACT_ROOT/integrated-solver-verification-v1/a3b/<config>/v3/<run-id>/; never inside the repository.
per_configuration_receipt: rejected/attempted/accepted counts and effective dt/CFL statistics

execution_gate.driver_note: The v3 driver must implement parent-binding acceptance, the v3 ledger carry-forward and the T1-A/v3 artifact subtree. It must be frozen by SHA-256 in a versioned execution addendum that references this protocol's SHA-256.
required_before_execution: V3 driver SHA-256 frozen in a versioned execution addendum that references this protocol's SHA-256.
Owner execution confirmation quoting the v3 protocol, driver and addendum SHA-256, the 600 s T1-A cap, the 4320 s global cap, the single invocation and the parent lineage hashes.
Lineage preflight with zero solver steps: parent protocol, checkpoint, result and ledger hashes; parent binding equality; scientific-field equality.
Zero-step preflight: identity, configuration, memory and artifact-root checks for all five configurations.
Confirmation that no historical preregistration or P0-P9 artifact is modified and that the v2 artifacts are byte-for-byte unchanged.
execution_gate.no_run_statement: No A3b T1-A cycle 3 has been run under this v3 protocol. No solver step has been executed. Execution requires the explicit owner authorization described above.

prohibitions: No mesh 6 configuration, no 6-cell contamination control, no noise repetition, and no fourth cycle.
No post-hoc extension of cycles, CFL or mesh; no retry or resume outside the frozen plan.
No change to the 600 s T1-A cap, the 4320 s global cap, the 600 s per-invocation cap or the 3072 MiB memory limit after this freeze.
No change to tolerances, observable set or classification after the v3 analysis-freeze commit.
No physics changes, no MUSCL, no P0-P9 modifications.
No edits to v1 or v2; v3 is a new frozen version that continues T1-A from the v2 checkpoint.
No T1-B..E execution under this protocol.
non_claims: A3b T1 is a first numerical sensitivity evaluation, not a definitive convergence closure.
No steady-state convergence and no periodicity identification.
No power or torque curve is produced by this protocol.
No claim outside the studied mesh/CFL domain.
No supported resolution domain from T1-A alone.
